user.title: MVM smart meters
user.description: Choose a folder containing MVM semicolon-delimited CSV reports. Reports for multiple meter serial numbers can share the folder; each meter gets its own device and statistics. New and overlapping reports are reconciled automatically. If your net balance resets annually, enter both rollover fields; otherwise leave both blank.

error.directory_not_found: The selected folder does not exist.
error.invalid_report: No valid measured MVM energy data was found. Check the CSV format, measured rows, and meter serials.
error.invalid_rollover_date: The annual rollover day is not valid for the selected month.

abort.already_configured: This report folder is already configured.
